title: Alex Eala’s fighting heart prevails again in gutsy win over Valentova
summary: Alex Eala has once again turned results in her favor in the final tournament of 2026 beating 19-year-old Tereza Valentova of the Czech Republic in two close sets at the Hong Kong WTA 250.
